newsitem.title: USA: Arctic Cat Q3 results in line with views.
newsitem.headline: Arctic Cat Q3 results in line with views.

text.p: Arctic Cat Inc said Thursday its earnings for the fiscal third quarter ended December 31 were in line with expectations.
Earlier, Arctic Cat reported third quarter earnings of $0.20 a share, even with a year ago. Sales for the quarter were $133.9 million, up from $123.6 million.

"Based on reports from dealers and distributors, we believe that the company is well on its way to its 14th consecutive year of increased retail sales of Arctic Cat snowmobiles," Christopher Twomey, president, said in a statement.
Arctic Cat sells snowmobiles and all-terrain vehicles under the Arctic Cat brand name and personal watercraft under the Tigershark brand name.

"Dealer and customer reception of our Arctic Cat all-terrain vehicle continues to be encouraging after completing our first year in this strategic market," Twomey said. "Our continued growth in this $1.2 billion market will be enhanced by the introduction of new models which will occur during our next fiscal year."
